name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's motorsport journey began in her youth, accompanying her father, a seasoned mechanic, to local rallies. The roar of the engines and the meticulous preparation captivated her. While she lacked the raw talent to be a driver, her sharp mind and organizational skills quickly became apparent. She began managing logistics for smaller teams, gaining invaluable experience in the paddock. Her break came when GCK Motorsport recognized her potential, offering her a position coordinating their test driver program.

Klara excels at balancing the needs of the engineering team with the preferences and feedback of the drivers. She possesses a remarkable ability to translate technical jargon into actionable insights for the drivers, and vice versa. Her approach is methodical and detail-oriented, ensuring every test session maximizes data collection and optimizes vehicle performance. What distinguishes Klara is her unwavering commitment to creating a supportive and collaborative environment, fostering open communication between all team members.

Beyond her professional life, Klara loves hiking in the Austrian Alps, and is known for baking traditional Sachertorte for her colleagues on special occasions. She believes a happy team is a fast team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Klara has a warm, friendly face framed by her auburn hair, and always wears a practical, no-nonsense expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously handwritten notes.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Austrian mineral water on hand during test sessions.
